results.title: Shadows
results.overview: What begins as rehearsal becomes revelation when two young women discover that performance can reveal truths the script never intended.

results.title: The Fever
results.overview: Returning home after years abroad, a man finds that the locals are now consumed by a desire to leave. As a feverish contagion of unnamed dread spreads among them, young people mysteriously vanish.

results.title: Roomies
results.overview: During a call with her best friend, a young woman vents about her increasingly bizarre roommate and the mental toll it's taking on her.

results.title: Caeneus
results.overview: When Caenis sees Caeneus on a punk stage, they know they want his body. Desire, envy and pain intertwine as Caenis obsessively hunts for Caeneus - and their true self.

results.title: The Navigator
results.overview: In 1980, Nainoa Thompson became the first Native Hawaiian in six centuries to navigate a voyaging canoe from Hawai'i to Tahiti without a compass or modern instruments. Nearly 50 years later, he embarks on the demanding open-ocean crossing one final time. He and a small crew of student navigators rely solely on the stars, nature's clues and lessons from the late master navigator Mau Piailug to guide them. As they sail 2,400 miles along the same sea road as their ancestors, they bear the responsibility of keeping this ancient knowledge alive. Naina sails not only to find an island but to search for something unseen. The Navigator reveals what is possible when we closely observe and deeply connect with the natural world.

results.title: Wet Whales
results.overview: Bodies drift at the water's edge, colliding with one another and surrendering to the rhythm of the waves. A harmonious interplay of sun, water, touch, and the simple joy of losing oneself together.

results.title: In the Name of Love
results.overview: A gay couple talks about love, visibility, and making erotic films together in Malaysia, where queer life has long been criminalized.

results.title: Split
results.overview: An intimate documentary exploring self-love, self-created erotica, and the fluidity of masculinity and femininity. Centering one individual’s relationship to their own body and desire, the film blurs the boundaries between artist, performer, and subject, framing erotic self-expression as an act of autonomy, reflection, and self-intimacy.

results.title: All the Rooms We Need
results.overview: Behind every door, a different room of life. A pregnancy to protect, one to terminate, a confused teenager, a disoriented mother. At the family planning clinic, they are all listened to. Every single one. All the Rooms We Need is a radical observational documentary that, for the first time, offers unprecedented access to the family planning clinic at Policlinico of Milan, a place where rights take the form of the faces, bodies, and everyday choices of the doctors who represent an essential public service. Moving freely between ages and timelines, within a single location, the film explores the doubts, fears, courage, laughter, and experiences of women and girls.

results.title: Aftertaste
results.overview: Sex produces knowledge. A knowledge that is rarely transmitted. Some facts about sapphic sex education.

results.title: Land of Metal
results.overview: A cam performer caught between algorithms, desire, and isolation begins to question the world around her. With its cyberpunk aesthetic and surreal narrative style, the film explores digital intimacy, control, and the search for connection beyond the screen.

results.title: The Sea Ate the Chair
results.overview: What year is it now? And what time is it? Why do I understand time?  On a walk by the sea I find myself asking questions that cannot be answered and cannot be left unasked.

results.title: Yes, Papasolini!
results.overview: Poetry, erotic imagery, and Pasolini’s words come together in a fragmented exploration of gay desire and the politics of the body. Navigating the space between intimacy and industry, the film reflects on how desire is shaped, circulated, and transformed.

results.title: The Date
results.overview: Blanca has a date with herself on the streets of Mexico City. Through pop aesthetics, femininity, and playful exhibitionism, the film explores the intimate relationship between a woman, her body, and the city where she lives.

results.title: Jerk It Off
results.overview: Seven protagonists with penises, seven inner worlds: their thoughts unfold in moments of self-pleasure.

results.title: Unlock
results.overview: After an accident abruptly ends his BDSM relationship, MilkBottle completes a final video task reflecting on his journey from Shandong, China to London, UK. As a webcam porn influencer, he confronts homophobia, sexual racism, and the blurred boundaries between digital and physical realms in search of a paradoxical ‘true self.’

results.title: This Is Not for Clients
results.overview: A sex worker’s subconscious is not for clients. Autofiction on desire, labour and life under capitalism.
